statement: Pinned xone binds a defined set of Xbox Wireless Adapter USB product IDs, requires separately supplied Microsoft adapter firmware, and initializes receiver-side transport before processing attached controllers. The driver handles pairing and receiver events itself rather than exposing an Xbox controller as a native USB gamepad on the adapter interface.

applicability.revision: Standard Xbox Series where applicable; xone GIP class path also supports other compatible models
applicability.scope: transport/dongle.c:20-46, 1076-1182, 1290-1350, 1547-1587; README.md:25-35, 126-142. Firmware prerequisite only: vendor-firmware content was not acquired or inspected.
